verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Codex Plugins uses MCP to let plugins expose capabilities *to* Codex/ChatGPT, and offers CLI commands (`codex plugin marketplace add`, `/plugins`) for local plugin management, but there is no documented public REST/GraphQL API for programmatically driving the Codex Plugins product itself — the direct OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate spec paths, confirming no discoverable public API surface.
